items.source: Creates a new EntityManagerFactoryDependsOnPostProcessor that will set up dependencies upon beans with the given types.
items.translation: 创建一个新的EntityManagerFactoryDependsOnPostProcessor，该处理器将设置对给定类型 bean 的依赖关系。

items.source: Creates a new EntityManagerFactoryDependsOnPostProcessor that will set up dependencies upon beans with the given names.
items.translation: 创建一个新的EntityManagerFactoryDependsOnPostProcessor，该处理器将设置对给定名称的 bean 的依赖关系。

items.source: dependsOn - names of the beans to depend upon
items.translation: dependsOn - 所依赖的 Bean 的名称

items.source: dependsOn - types of the beans to depend upon
items.translation: dependsOn - 所依赖的 Bean 的类型

items.source: Marcel Overdijk, Dave Syer, Phillip Webb, Andy Wilkinson, Andrii Hrytsiuk
items.translation: Marcel Overdijk, Dave Syer, Phillip Webb, Andy Wilkinson, Andrii Hrytsiuk

items.source: BeanFactoryPostProcessor that can be used to dynamically declare that all EntityManagerFactory beans should "depend on" one or more specific beans.
items.translation: BeanFactoryPostProcessor 可用于动态声明所有 EntityManagerFactory Bean 应“依赖”一个或多个特定 Bean。
